# 正交性

## 正交矩阵和格拉姆 - 施密特正交化

[Sympy 怎么求 Q](../appendices/4.md#sympy-怎么求-q)

```{python}
from sympy import Matrix, pprint, GramSchmidt
import sympy as sp
from IPython.display import display

a = sp.Matrix([[1], [-1], [0]])

b = sp.Matrix([[2], [0], [-2]])

c = sp.Matrix([[3], [-3], [3]])

display(GramSchmidt([a, b, c], True))
display(*GramSchmidt([a, b, c], True))
```

```{python}
import sympy as sp
from IPython.display import display


A = sp.Matrix([
    [1, 2, 3],
    [-1, 0, -3],
    [0, -2, 3],
])
display(A.QRdecomposition())
display(*A.QRdecomposition())
```
